claim_text: T-FNO and U-Net form a statistically confirmed Pareto trade-off on the tutorial split
effect_size: T-FNO better by 0.50190 on int-T RMSE; U-Net better by 0.04494 on mass MAE
allowed_wording: T-FNO significantly better on interface-temperature fidelity; U-Net significantly better on mass conservation
forbidden_wording: T-FNO wins overall; U-Net wins overall

claim_text: No overall GWRMSE winner was established on the tutorial split
allowed_wording: No statistically significant GWRMSE winner was established (Holm p=1.0)
forbidden_wording: T-FNO better at GWRMSE; U-Net worse at GWRMSE

claim_text: The tutorial ranking did not replicate under the independent cross-condition protocol
effect_size: all diffs favor U-Net descriptively; min p=.0625; all Holm=1.0
allowed_wording: Descriptively consistent reversal; statistical power insufficient for confirmation
forbidden_wording: U-Net confirmed superior on cross-condition; ranking is established

claim_text: Physical alpha bounding prevents out-of-range predictions under rollout
evidence_artifact: Phase 1 unbounded vs bounded rollout results
allowed_wording: Physical bounding constrains alpha to [0,1] by construction
forbidden_wording: Bounded models necessarily perform better; bounding validates CHF detection

claim_text: Single-seed rollout reversal after bounding did not replicate under multi-seed test
allowed_wording: The single-seed reversal did not replicate (Holm p=1.0 across full 21-metric family)
forbidden_wording: Physical bounding improved rollout tracking accuracy; bounding is architecturally beneficial

claim_text: Divergence penalty achieves mass-conservation non-inferiority at lambda=0.30 (tutorial split)
allowed_wording: Divergence hybrid (lambda=0.30) achieves predeclared mass-conservation non-inferiority to U-Net (p=0.000488)
forbidden_wording: Divergence penalty recovers all performance gaps; lambda=0.30 is the optimal value

claim_text: Divergence penalty conservation benefit transferred directionally to cross-condition test
effect_size: hybrid mass MAE 0.08669 vs U-Net 0.11560; diff -0.02891
allowed_wording: Divergence hybrid mass-conservation advantage transferred directionally; not yet confirmatory at cross-condition
forbidden_wording: Divergence penalty is confirmed superior on cross-condition; conservation benefit is established across conditions

claim_text: CHF dry-area proxy shows no sustained event in any available trajectory
evidence_artifact: Phase 2 dry-area traces; multitraj96 CHF check
effect_size: No trajectory exceeds threshold for 3 consecutive frames
allowed_wording: No sustained dry-area precursor event detected in available trajectories
forbidden_wording: CHF events detected; CHF proxy validated; neural operators can predict CHF

claim_text: EXPLORATORY: Stored 96x96 tutorial-split n=11 paired T-FNO-U-Net differences show opposite sign to 48x48 for 3 of 4 metrics
statistical_test: exact sign-flip + Holm-Bonferroni (exploratory, not predeclared confirmatory test)
effect_size: GWRMSE mean +0.10868 (Holm 0.00391); int-T RMSE +0.46219 (Holm 0.00977); jump MAE +0.21433 (Holm 0.00391); mass MAE +0.04906 (Holm 0.00391)
confidence_interval: N/A (bootstrapped CI not yet computed for 96x96 n=11)
allowed_wording: Stored 96x96 pipeline produces reversed paired differences relative to 48x48 pipeline; this is a descriptive observation across non-equivalent configurations
forbidden_wording: Resolution caused the ranking reversal; T-FNO is better at low resolution; U-Net is better at high resolution; architecture x resolution interaction is established

claim_text: The tutorial and cross-condition protocols also differ in spatial resolution
allowed_wording: The protocols differed in spatial resolution (48x48 vs 96x96) as well as trajectory conditions
forbidden_wording: The wall-temperature change caused the ranking reversal; resolution caused the ranking reversal
